_note: Mock example only. Not generated from production data. Field names are illustrative and do not reflect the actual private schema.
_purpose: Show the shape of a mission scorecard: the done criteria the Owner locked at approval, each judged met or unmet from evidence assembled in code, with the gap declared rather than hidden. Done is a contract, not an opinion; the worker never marks its own criterion met. See docs/how-it-works.md, section 5, and docs/earned-autonomy.md.
title: Summarize this morning's meeting notes
_criteria_note: Kora proposed these when the mission opened; the Owner edited one and approved the set. After this moment the worker cannot change them.

verdict._verdict_note: The verifier is external to the worker. It reads the criteria verbatim, the workspace listing, excerpts of the actual files, and the step results. A criterion that was met un-meets itself if its artifact disappears.

criteria._note: Whatever can be counted is counted by code on every pass and never asked of a model.

criteria.text: Every decision in the summary cites the line of the notes it came from.
criteria._note: A citation check scores each claim against the passage it cites in the source document; a claim is checked whole, never as a fragment.

criteria.text: The summary covers every agenda item that appears in the notes.

evidence.quote: budget review, hiring plan, and launch

criteria._note: A judged criterion is met only when the verifier can quote consecutive words from the product itself as its evidence.

criteria.text: Each action item names an owner.
criteria.reason: Two of five action items name no owner; the notes do not state one.
criteria._note: An unmet criterion is stated with its reason. A disclaimer cannot make it met.

gaps.why: The source notes do not name them; nothing in the library supplies them.
gaps.what_would_change_it: The Owner names the two owners, or approves the summary as is.

_gaps_note: The missing-and-why list is rendered from records, never written by the model.

delivery.what_is_unresolved: c4: two action items have no owner.
delivery._note: Every final stop delivers the work so far with what is unresolved. A judge's refusal does not stop the mission; it sends the work back for repair. Only a budget stop, a block on the Owner's authority, or a genuine dead end ends a run.
